chunks: And it was narrated from ʿAmr ibn Shimr, from his father, who said:
I saw Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام wearing a light burd while he was in the state of ihram.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam being described
key_terms.عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ: ʿAmr ibn Shimr, a narrator in the chain

ai.seo_question: What kind of clothing was Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام seen wearing while in the state of ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام was seen wearing a light burd while in the state of ihram. It is relevant to the jurisprudence of hajj and what is permissible to wear during ihram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2598 - It was narrated from Amr ibn Shimmar, from his father, who said:
"I saw Abu Ja'far (as) wearing a lightweight striped cloak (burd mukhaffaf) while he was in the state of Ihram."
